title: Smoky Dutch Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew with a rich, smoky flavor from the ancho chilli. Perfect for a cold winter's day.

ingredients.name: Warm beer
ingredients.notes: used to add depth of flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the chopped carrot and potato, cook for 5 minutes.
Add the stew beef, cook until browned on all sides.
Add the ancho chilli, chilli powder, salt and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the warm beer and water. Stir to combine.
Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
